pattern: SVG part-to-whole chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "pie chart" or "donut chart") of role="img" slices with roving focus; legend of toggle buttons with each share; data table fallback with value and percent columns.

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription (localized chart type), named by the title
img with an aria-label: category/x, series, formatted value
list (ul) named "Legend"; entries are toggle buttons (aria-pressed)
table (native) with caption, column headers, and row headers; wide tables scroll in a focusable region

roles.element: axes, lines, textures, value labels, tooltip
roles.role: aria-hidden (decorative duplicates of the accessible data)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id
Localized chart type, for example "line chart"
0 on exactly one mark (roving); other marks have none
true while the series is visible
Table open state and the table region id

keyboard.action: Next slice (clockwise); ArrowLeft/ArrowRight are swapped in RTL.
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
Legend buttons, then one tab stop for the plot (the active mark), then the Show data table button and table region.
Shows or hides the series (native button).

focus: Roving focus: one mark is in the tab sequence and remembers the last visited data point, also across re-renders (resize, update). Toggling a legend entry keeps focus on its button; toggling the table keeps focus on the table button.
notes: The generated summary lists the chart type, series and point counts, axis ranges, per-series minimum and maximum with their positions, the overall trend, missing values, and hidden series.
Meaning never depends on color alone: marker shapes, dash patterns, and textures (patterns option), plus legend keys that repeat them.
Forced colors: series use CanvasText and keep shapes, dashes, and textures; focus uses Highlight.
No animation: nothing moves on render; hover and focus emphasis transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion and animation: none.
Slices are separated by a surface-colored stroke, so adjacent slices never depend on the contrast between two series colors.
Percentages are recomputed over visible slices when slices are hidden.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
aria-roledescription support varies; screen readers without it announce "group".
